title: Fuel-station workers protest delayed wages
reason: Before assigned month; private contractor wage dispute, with no verified state demand or attendance threshold.
notes: Gulf News's Jan. 2 update says Tuesday, implying Dec. 29; Gohod's unread Dec. 30 snippet says it began the day before. Exact onset remains provisional. KNPC customer apology and public calls for worker protection are not verified state accommodation or protesters' demand.

title: Parliamentary motion and cabinet resignation
reason: Government/parliament process without evidence of a public protest gathering.
notes: Jan. 5 motion and Jan. 12 resignation are process dates, not assembly dates. No crowd or event start assigned.

title: Announced Kuwait Salons Union sit-in

title: Bidun activists sentenced after an earlier sit-in
reason: Sentencing report does not establish a January 2021 public assembly.
notes: HRW labels its chapter Events of 2020 and reports Jan. 28 sentencing after an earlier sit-in; the court date is not the gathering date.
